# ~FROM is rewritten but not moved: build paths (.o, .elf) and paths relative to userland/.

# data/usr/share/services), plus init. One directory each:
# Utilities stay flat, one file one program:

# Windows Setup, hlpbroker) and upd (/bin/update, System Update). Not userland/shared/: that
# is the BUILD directory of kernel/lib's ring-3 copies (build/userland/shared/).
